segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Megan at Northstar Clinics. I'm looking at our June statement, invoice 48291, and there’s a $1,260 professional services line on there that we didn’t approve or schedule.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can take a look. Can you confirm the billing email or the last four digits of the account ID?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, billing is ap@northstarclinics.com, account ID ends in 7714.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks. I’ve got the account open in the billing tool. Give me just a second to check the activity tied to that invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. We’re trying to close the month by Friday, so I just need to know if we should hold payment.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Understood. I’m seeing your regular 84 seats and the standard support package. The extra charge was added from a service task, but I don’t see the matching approval note in the ticketing system.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I thought. We had a short call with your onboarding team, but nothing billable was discussed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m going to open a billing review and pause collection on this invoice while it’s checked. The case number is 318746, and you’ll get an email confirmation in a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. Do you need anything else from me?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Not right now. If finance needs backup, they’ll reply on the case, but I added your note and the timing. You can wait on payment until the corrected invoice or confirmation comes through.
